result.stdout:
Description:
  A command line and MCP tool for Lumoin.Veridical.

Usage:
  veridical [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  info          Print platform and scalar-backend information.
  hash <input>  Compute the BLAKE3-256 hash of an input.
  selftest      Run the known-answer conformance vectors (exit non-zero on failure).
